title: GrantThai structured-field value contracts
description: Draft. One value schema per registry field whose type is array<object>, object or rich_text|object, keyed by field_id under $defs; plus the record-level `links` object. A field record's non-null `value` must validate against $defs[<field_id>] (rule S002; tools/ci/check_schema_lint.py checks shipped examples). Keys are derived from the handoff package core/02 (founder-owned, K13) with the renames stated in each description; see spec/common/links-and-sources.md for the link model. Annotation keywords: x-grantthai-node (on an item schema: id_prefix, node_type), x-grantthai-ref (on every *_id / *_ids property: targets, edge, direction, source_types), x-grantthai-derived-from (lineage). Drafting rule: every key except `id` may be omitted or null while drafting; a rule that needs a missing key reports its own finding and never treats the key as zero or as a default.

_node_id.description: A node id: an item id (prefix + digits) or a field record's field_id.

_money.description: Thai baht. At most 2 fractional digits; validators convert with Decimal(repr(value)) and compare after quantising to 0.01.

_percent.description: Percent 0-100; sums are compared after quantising to 0.01.

record_links.description: Record-level links on a field record (spec/common/field_record.schema.json `links`). Each key is allowed only on records whose chain node is in its x-grantthai-ref.source_types.

gap_ids.description: On an RQ record: the gap this question addresses (R003).

prior_knowledge_ids.description: On the Gap record: the prior-knowledge records it rests on (R002).

observation_ids.description: On the Problem record (Citizen Mode, v0.2).

experience_ids.description: On an Observation record (Citizen Mode, v0.2).

analysis_ids.description: On an Evidence record: the analysis that produced it.

output_ids.description: On a Claim record: the outputs that carry the claim.

kr_ids.description: On the Need record: feedback edge KR -> Need; exempt from CH001.
